description: React context provider component for authentication using Supabase, managing user sessions, roles, and authentication state.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: React component providing authentication context, managing user session, roles, and auth state.

methods.name: useAuth
methods.description: Custom hook to access authentication context.

methods.name: setLocalRole
methods.description: Stores user role in localStorage as a fallback.

methods.name: getRoleFromMetadata
methods.description: Extracts user role from Supabase user metadata.

methods.name: setRoleInMetadata
methods.description: Updates user role in Supabase user_metadata and local fallback.

methods.name: signIn
methods.description: Authenticates user via email/password and optionally sets user role.

methods.name: signOut
methods.description: Signs out user and clears session and role data.

methods.name: signUp
methods.description: Creates new user account with email/password and optional role.
